text:
maria: Quick sync — WG to finalize GPU health scoring dashboard and SLOs? Noticed a spike in Xid errors in us-west-2 last night.

sam: I saw that. Node gtx-12 had 3 Xid=31 events within ~20m and kernel started isolating contexts. Can we add a per-GPU Xid rate panel (5m/1h) + alerting? :eyes: 

ajay: Proposal for health score: base 100, subtract penalties: Xid_rate penalty capped, ECC_uncorrected heavy penalty, age penalty for older cards. Show per-region aggregate + 99th percentile across pods.

katie: We need concrete alert thresholds mapped to actions. Suggest: health < 90 -> channel notification, health < 85 -> page on-call. Also include an ops cost note for drain/replace.

infra-bot: Grafana: 'gpu-health-score-v2' deployed to staging. Ingested metrics: nvidia_gpu_xid_errors_total, nvidia_gpu_ecc_uncorrectable_total, nvidia_gpu_ecc_correctable_total, nvidia_gpu_temp_celsius, gpu_sm_utilization, gpu_memory_errors_total.

maria: Sharing PromQL snippets for panels/alerts — sanity-check please, will iterate: 

```promql
sum(rate(nvidia_gpu_xid_errors_total{job="node-exporter"}[5m])) by (gpu_id, region)
```

and ECC uncorrectable check: 

```promql
increase(nvidia_gpu_ecc_uncorrectable_total[1h])
```

sam: LGTM but recommend normalizing Xid rate by active inference sessions or token throughput per GPU to avoid penalizing tiny test nodes. Also add a 1h burn-rate panel to catch slow leaks.

ajay: Agreed. Also propose age factor: age_penalty = clamp((years_in_service - 1) * 2, 0, 20) so cards >1y start accumulating small penalty.

katie: Runbook change suggestion: if ECC_uncorrected > 0 -> isolate GPU immediately: cordon node, drain pods (`kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m`), mark GPU as quarantined in inventory, and trigger replacement workflow. Document steps in ops playbook.

maria: :thumbsup: I'll draft the alert rules. Draft SLOs for GPUs: regional health SLO 99.8% monthly for available healthy-GPU capacity (excludes scheduled maintenance), mean time to replace failing GPU < 6h for Dedicated customers.

sam: One more: should routing fallback be automatic when a region's health drops? e.g., route new sessions to spare pool or alternate region to avoid user impact.

ajay: Yes — smart routing reduces blast radius. Add Grafana annotations when fallback triggers to correlate with traffic shifts. Also surface per-model latency delta when routing happens.

katie: Cost callout: routing to spare/dedicated pools increases per-token cost roughly 1.7–2x. Need finance signoff if we expand spare capacity or increase automatic fallback budgets.

maria: I'll open infra ticket #3421 to track dashboard, alert rules, runbook updates, and cost analysis. Dashboard link (staging): https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/abc123/gpu-health-score-v2 — will be behind staging until QA pass.

infra-bot: Alert created: GPU_Health_Region_Low (severity=warning). Condition: health < 90 for 15m. Pager policy: escalate if health < 85 for 10m. Silence windows for scheduled maintenance supported.

sam: OK let's run chaos+runbook in staging tomorrow 10:00 PT — will invite eng-sre to validate drain/replace automation.

katie: Calendar invite sent. Thanks all — will update runbook PR after staging run.

ops-sre: quick note: add a panel for ECC_correctable rate trend — spikes often precede uncorrectable events. Correlate with ambient temp and power capping.

maria: Good call. I'll add temp+powercap overlay. Will also add per-region spare capacity ratio and a cost column.

katie: Final ask: include a CSV export panel for weekly health reports for finance and customer success.

maria: added to ticket. Will follow up with a short doc summarizing scoring formula and SLOs.
